rules.remediation: Move composting behavior to the 26.3 item-component/data-driven path using DataComponents.COMPOSTABLE or target-native equivalent.
Use DataComponents.COOKING_FUEL or the current target-native component/data path.
Port brewing recipes to 26.3 data-driven recipe data and use DataComponents.BREWING_FUEL where applicable.
Port to vanilla block-transformer data/component behavior for stripping.
Port to vanilla block-transformer data/component behavior for tilling.
Port to vanilla block-transformer data/component behavior for flattening.

rules.summary: The previous colored vanilla fluid-name helper changed in the 26.3 fluids API.
rules.remediation: Migrate to FluidVariantAttributes.getColoredName and re-check fluid rendering/name behavior.

rules.summary: Minecraft 26.3 removed GLFW in favor of SDL; direct GLFW constants/calls are not a safe 26.3 input abstraction.
rules.remediation: Use vanilla InputConstants and target-native input APIs; custom text widgets must integrate with the current TextInputManager behavior.

rules.summary: 26.3 worldgen feature data was reorganized; configured features moved/combined into worldgen/feature.
rules.remediation: Translate configured feature resources and code to the 26.3 worldgen/feature model and validate registry references.

rules.summary: Surface rules were renamed/reworked as material rules in the 26.3 worldgen model.
rules.remediation: Port data/code to worldgen/material_rule and current material-condition registrations.

rules.summary: Block codecs / the prior block_type registry changed or were removed in 26.3.
rules.remediation: Review custom block serialization/registration against the 26.3 block construction and registry model instead of carrying old block codecs verbatim.

rules.summary: Forge package references remain in a NeoForge 26.3 target candidate.
rules.remediation: Resolve each Forge-owned type/event/capability/config hook to its NeoForge 26.3 owner or an explicit compatibility dependency.

rules.summary: A legacy Forge mods.toml is present in a NeoForge target candidate.
rules.remediation: Use the current NeoForge mod metadata template (normally META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml or generated template metadata) and migrate dependency declarations.

rules.summary: The project explicitly targets Java below 25.
rules.remediation: Move the 26.3 target build/toolchain to Java 25, then fix source/API failures rather than suppressing the target level.

rules.summary: A Fabric 26.3 target still declares Yarn mappings even though Minecraft 26.1+ is unobfuscated.
rules.remediation: Use official/unobfuscated 26.3 names. Harvest Yarn only as historical source-migration evidence; do not add it to the finished 26.3 target.

rules.summary: A Fabric 26.3 target still carries an Intermediary mapping declaration.
rules.remediation: Translate historical Intermediary names through the mapping lineage cache, then keep the 26.3 target in official names.

rules.summary: Historical MCP/SRG/Intermediary symbol names remain in a 26.3 target candidate.
rules.remediation: Resolve the declaring owner and exact JVM descriptor through authoritative historical mappings, translate to the current official 26.3 symbol, then re-audit Mixins/reflection/access files separately.
